# Traceback Workspaces & Projects

Manage your organizational context and test suites.

## Commands

```sh
traceback workspaces           # Interactively select the active workspace
traceback project list         # List all projects in the current workspace
traceback project get <id>     # Inspect project details and test suites
traceback project delete <id>  # Remove a project
```

Use `--workspace <id>` flag on test commands to override the active workspace on a per-command basis.
